tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: rta mchog rol pa'i snying tig bzhugs: 1$0000250slob dpon nā gardzu na'i dgongs pa'o// 1$0000300

rdo rje rta yi rgyal por 'dud: gnas lugs rta yi mgrin pa can: thabs grol lam gyi mchog tu snang: 'bras bu mthar phyin rol pa yis: 'gro 'dul phrin las lhun gyis grub: sa ma ya: de nyid nyams su blang ba'i slad: pad+ma dbang gi spyi bo nas: myur mgyogs shugs ldan gdong pa yis: i hi'i rta dbyangs 'tsher ba las: dang por gnas lugs stong pa nyid: lta ba gtan la 'beb pa'i phyir: nges 'byung dang ni snying rje bskyed: skyabs song byang chub sems bskyed nas: snod du rung ba'i slob ma la: rim pa dbang gis smin pa'i phyir: dkyil 'khor dmar nag mtshan rdzogs bzhengs: brda yi dbang rdzas thams cad dgram: khyad par rta zhal sngags mtshan pa: dal gyi dbus su brtan par bzhugs: bdag mdun bskyed bzlas nus ldan bya: bdag nyid 'jug cing slob ma rnams: dag pa bdud rtsi'i khrus nas dbyung: byur dang mi shis bsal ba'i phyir: 'bras zan changs bu ting lor bcas: nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlab: bsngo zhing bka' bsgo bya ba ni: hūm̐: khams gsum 'di na su yang rung: gsang ba sgrub la bar chad bgegs: gtor ma 'dod yon rgya mtsho longs: rang rang gnas su myur du dengs: slar yang nag phyogs gdug pa can: drag po rdo rje'i sngags kyis bskrad: hrī: phyi snod thams cad rdo rje'i gur: nang bcud khrag 'thung rol pa'i lha: sems nyid gdod nas skye med dbyings: gzung 'dzin bgegs tshogs mtshams bcad do: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: zhes pa'i srung 'khor gsal brtan bsgom: nges 'byung blo bcos maṇ+ḍal bcas: thal mo sbyar te gsol ba gdab: ho: pad+ma gzi ldan dgyes rol pa'i: bla ma dbang mchog he ru kas: bdag cag skal ldan slob ma la: ye shes mchog gi dbang bskur stsol: lan gsum rjes su skyabs sems dang: rgyud sbyang tshogs gsag sdom pa bzung: ye shes dbab cing brtan par bya: bum pa'i bdud rtsis gtor zhing bkru:

oṃ: bkra shis bum pa'i bdud rtsi'i chus: gtor zhing blugs pa'i dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs lnga yi sgrib dag ste: ye shes lnga ru lhun rdzogs shog: hrīḥ.oṃ trāṃ hūm̐ ā: ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rjes 'brel gsang gsum phyag rgya bstim: hrī: sku ni snang stong gzung 'dzin bral: gsung dbyangs rdo rje'i sngags su 'tsher: thugs ni bde stong nyams dang ldan: ye shes sku yi dbang bskur ro: kā ya dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: bzlas pa'i lung sbyin brtan par bya: hrī: srid pa'i 'byung ba las kyi rlung: dbu ma'i dbyings su thim pa las: gnad nas skul ba'i sngags kyi sgo: grags stong chen por dbang bskur ro: wā ka dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hrī: dbyings ni rdo rje rta yi zhal: rig pa 'gag med yi ge'i sprin: zung 'jug gnas lugs gnyug ma'i babs: 'od gsal thugs su dbang bskur ro: tsit+ta dz+nyān a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: bla ma yab yum byang sems sbyin: ā: byang chub sems kyi ye ge ni: hrīḥyig zhun mar 'khyil pa'i bcud: rtsa khams rlung la bstims pa las: gsal stong zung 'jug mngon gyur shog: hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥbo dhi tsit+ta dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: mtshan ldan gzungs mar sbyor du gzhug: hūm̐: 'di ni chos kun 'byung ba'i gnas: pad+ma gzi ldan chen po ste: rol cig rdo rje rta yi mgrin: bcu drug dga' ba'i ngang nas rol: karma mu dra dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nyid rten byas brten pa ni: rdo rje'i dbyangs kyis ngo sprod gdab: hī hī hī: rdo rje'i rta skad 'tsher ba'i dbyangs: gsal zhing brjid pa'i gdangs chen po: rang byung nam mkha'i dkyil nas bsgrags: bde stong nyams kyi ngo bor ltos: de la rtse gcig mnyam gzhag pas: dang po skye med stong sang nge: bar du gnas med zang thal le: tha ma 'gag med rjen ce re: rang bzhin yongs shes dran pa'i ngang: yid mig rlung gsum dbyer med 'jog:

'di don rtogs na don gyi dbang: pad+ma dbang chen tshe 'dir 'grub: dhā tu dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma lhar gsal spyi bor bzhag: hrī: dang por lha yi ngo bor bsgrubs: bar du ye shes gzi byin 'bar: tha mar dngos grub dbyig tu 'khyil: yongs rdzogs gtor ma'i dbang bskur ro: sarba ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor: rdo rje'i glu blang tshogs 'khor bya: sa ma ya: de ltar dbang gis rgyud smin nas: thog mar gnas lugs gtan la phab: phyi rol snang ba ji snyed kun: rang snang yin te rmi lam 'dra: snang ba ma 'gags sgyu ma 'dra: rang bzhin bden med chu zla 'dra: snang mkhan sems la tshur dpyad pas: ches phra'i ye shes nang du gsal: stong nyid rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil: rdul bral 'dus ma byas pa ste: rang gi rang bzhin de kho na: 'di ni gsal ba 'khor ba ste: 'di ni rang bzhin mya ngan 'das: 'khor 'das dbyer med don rtogs na: gang bltas pad+ma dbang gi lha: ci spyod gzi ldan rol pa'i yum: de kho na nyid mngon du 'gyur: sa ma ya: lta ba rtogs nas thabs grol lam: zab mo'i ting 'dzin bsgom pa ni: 'di ltar snang ba thams cad kun: snang tsam nyid las 'ga' med kyang: de la zhen pas 'khor bar 'ching: de phyir de nyid sbyang ba'i phyir: thog mar bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom: mtshan nyid tshang ba'i bris sku dgram: stong pa'i babs su yun ring bzhag: gsal ba'i gdangs la ce re blta: 'gag med hrīḥyig wal gyis bsgom: de la rtse gcig sems bzung nas: yul gsum gsal bar gyur pa na: rten dang brten pa'i lha sku bsgom: spyi dang bye brag gsal snang la: rtse gcig sems bzung gsal snang bsgrub: nga rgyal brtan po nye bar bzhag: gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med pa'i: dag pa dran pas lam du khyer: srog rtsol bzlas pa sngags kyis sbyang: stong pa bzhi yi sdud rim dang: dbyer med 'od gsal ngang du 'jog:

res 'ga' lha sngags lam du slong: res 'ga' rlung gi sbyor ba dang: res 'ga' sems dang ro mnyam blta: de ltar yang yang goms pa las: snang ba lha skur rang shar na: zhon pa'i rta ni rlung yin pas: rlung gi srog rtsol dbu mar bcad: lus gnad bsrang zhing rlung ro bsal: byed pa bcing phyir lta stangs gzir: stong pa'i gzugs brnyan cir yang 'char: rdo rje'i bzlas pas lam sbyangs te: bum pa can gyi sbyor bas brtan: zhu bde'i rnal 'byor rjes dran pas: mi 'gyur bde ba'i ting 'dzin bsgrub: de las ye shes ris med pa: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can: tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: phrin las byang bu bstan pa ni: skyabs sems tshogs gsag bgegs bskrad bsrung: byin dbab mchod pa byin gyis brlab: a: rta mgrin rgyal po de bzhin nyid: ma bcos ma bslad gnyug ma'i gshis: dmigs med snying rje mchog gi gdangs: 'gag med zang thal kun tu shar: rol pa chen po'i cho 'phrul las: rgyu yi sa bon hrīḥdamar po: sngags kyi sgra gdangs dang bcas pas: khams gsum stong zhing dbyings su thim: rgyu las e yaṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ: 'phros pas 'byung ba rim brtsegs steng: ri rab steng du srung 'khor dbus: dbang chen gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus zla gam 'bar ba'i dkyil: pad+ma nyi zla klu srin steng: hrīḥlas rta mchog rol pa ni: sgeg dpa' 'jigs su rung ba'i sku: ye shes lnga yi zhal dang ldan: rdo rje rta yi gdong pas mtshan: stong nyid bcu drug rol pa'i phyag: pad+ma rin chen ral gri dang: lcags kyu zhags pa dbyug to gdengs: sbrul dang snying phreng g.yas na bsnams: thod khrag 'khor lo gtun shing dang: lcags sgrog dril bu mda' dang gzhu: stong gi 'jig rten g.yon na brjid: dpal dang dur khrod chas kun rdzogs: yum ni pad+ma gzi ldan ma: dmar smug pad+ma thod khrag 'dzin: mnyam sbyor brkyang bskum dor stabs kyis:

ye shes me phung klong na 'gyings: tshogs drug sum cu rtsa gnyis khams: nyon mongs bcu drug mtha' bzhi'i lta: rnam dag kham rgya dmus long dang: khyi spyang sgo ma'i tshogs dang bcas: dpal chen sku yi dbyings su rdzogs: sprul pa sna tshogs spro zhing sdud: dgod gshe drag shul gsung mchog gis: 'jig rten gsum po 'dar zhing g.yo: snying rje rngams dang zhi ba'i thugs: mkha' la nyi gsal 'od bzhin khyab: spyi mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐: rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor rdzogs: byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i chus: sku lnga yongs rdzogs mchog dbang bskur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hrīḥ.oṃ trāṃ hūm̐ ā: hrī: mgon po kun gshegs snying rje'i bdag: rta mchog rnam par rol pa'i lha: gtso 'khor sprul pa yang sprul bcas: thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir byon: hrīḥha ya grī wa e ā ral+li dza: ho: byams pa'i lcags kyus thugs rgyud bskul: snying rje'i zhags pas rten dang bsre: dga' ba'i sgrog gis ro mnyam bcing: btang snyoms dril bus ye shes bskyed: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ: ho: rdo rje'i longs spyod chen po ni: phyi nang gsang ba bla na med: kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin: yul dang dbang po gnyis med rol: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga sarba pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañca a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: thabs mchog bde chen rdo rje rta mgrin rgyal: shes rab pad+ma gzi ldan yum dang sbyor: gnyis med sprul pa rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro: dbang chen yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: rang byung 'od gsal thugs kyi dbyings: ye shes sems ma gzi ldan yum: rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa'i sku: dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can: de yi tsit+ta'i gur khang du: nyi steng hrīḥl sngags kyis bskor: 'od zer mchod pa'i sprin du 'phros: rgyal ba mnyes mchod 'gro kun gyi: sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa sbyangs:

snod bcud ma lus dbang du bsdus: 'od dmar gzi brjid 'bar bar bsgom: oṃ hu lu hu lu e ā ral+li hrīḥdza: bsgom dang bzlas pas dngos grub thob: thun mtshams tshogs kyi mchod pa bya: rjes su mchod bstod dngos grub gsol: nongs pa bshags shing ye shes lha: 'od gsal gnyug ma'i dbyings su bsdu: rig pa rang snang rol pa'i sprin: yul kun rdo rje rta yi mgrin: yul can bde stong phyag rgyas gdab: dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam dang: shis pa brjod pas mthar dbyung ngo: sa ma ya: gnas skabs phrin las rnam pa bzhi: rdo rje bro yi cho gas bsgrub: tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ru: lu gu rgyud du sbrel bsdams nas: so so'i las kyi dbyibs mthun pa'i: bro ra bca' zhing sngags tshig bskul: rkang pa'i stabs kyis gar bsgyur bas: las kun 'grub cing phyir mi ldog: oṃ: e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje rta mchog nga rgyal gyis: me long ye shes bro brdungs pas: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi bar shog: oṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: bh+rūm̐: waṃ gi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: rat+na rta mchog nga rgyal gyis: mnyam nyid ye shes bro brdungs pas: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas par shog: bh+rūm̐ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ: hrī: mā yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: pad+ma rta mchog nga rgyal gyis: sor rtog ye shes bro brdungs pas: khams gsum dbang du 'du bar shog: hrīḥwā shaṃ ku ru ho: hūm̐: yā yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: karma rta mchog nga rgyal gyis: bya grub ye shes bro brdungs pas: mi mthun phyogs kun tshar gcod shog: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭa: thal mo sprul pa'i 'od zer sprin: las mthun 'jig rten khams kun khyab: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi: phrin las mtha' dag lhun grub bsam: sa ma ya: mthar thug 'bras bu 'grub byed ni: rim pa dbang gis rgyud smin nas: dam tshig rnam par dag pa yis:

gzhi don lta ba gtan la phab: bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas pas: sngags kyi tshogs lam yongs su bgrod: rlung sems las rung drod dang rtse/ thig le zag med bde rdzogs pas: bzod pa chos mchog mngon byas te: don gyi lhan skyes mthong ba'i lam: de las slob dang mi slob pa'i: zung 'jug ye shes mngon gyur te: 'khor 'das gnyis med kun gyi srog: mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos bzhin: gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sprin: rta mchog rol pa tshe 'dir 'grub: sa ma ya: thun mong bkra shis tshe yi lung: zab rgyas gzhan las khyad 'phags pa: rta mchog chen po'i ting nge 'dzin: mi shigs snying po'i bcud len ni: tshe bca' byin bskyed lha gsal zhing: sngags bzla tshe 'gugs tshe bcings nas: tshe dbang dngos grub blang bar bya: snying po lnga yi phye ma dang: gal gyi mthun bsdebs 'brang rgyas ni: rta mchog zhal gyi phyag rgyar ldan: dngos grub ya mtshan rdzas rnams bsham: hūm̐: mi mngon rang byung dbyings kyi pho brang nas: rig pa'i rtsal las shar pa'i dkyil 'khor pa: pad+ma dbang chen tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: 'dir gshegs 'dir bzhugs byin phob dbang mchog skur: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud thig le gcig tu skyil: dwangs ma ye shes gzi byin phyogs bcur spros: sgrub pa'i rdzas la nus pa'i bcud chen phobs: 'chi med ye shes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ ha ya grī wa ā yur+dz+nyā na a we sha ya hring hring pheṃ pheṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag mdun dbang chen rta mchog dpal: nyi ma 'char kha'i mdangs 'od can: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: pad+ma lcags kyu zhags pa g.yas: tshe bum lcags sgrog dril bu gsil: gzi ldan lcags kyu thod pa 'dzin: dpal dang dur khrod rol pa'i chas: spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur las: hi hi'i dbyangs su rab 'tsher bas: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud dbang med sdud: pad nyi dregs pa lha chen steng: ye shes me dbus 'gying zhing rol:

gar dgus brjid pa'i sku mchog las: kham rgya dmus long lce spyang sogs: pho nya dregs pa'i 'phro 'du yis: tshe bkug byin skyed srid dang zhi'i: dngos grub ma lus stsol bar bsam: byin brlab dbang bskur spyan 'dren sogs: las kyi rim pa ci rigs bya: thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: hūm̐ nṛ a yi tshe rten la: 'chi med rdo rje'i sngags kyi phreng: lu gu rgyud du bskor ba las: 'od 'phros pho nya'i thugs dam bskul: sprul pa yang sprul bka' nyan bcas: nam mkha'i khams nas glog ltar 'khyugs: bar snang khams nas sprin ltar g.yos: sa gzhi'i khams nas rlangs ltar brdol: khams gsum thams cad shig shig g.yos: srid gsum dregs pa 'dar zhing bsngangs: brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud dbang med 'phrogs: 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi ni: nyi ma 'char kha'i 'od lta bu: snying dbus tshe rten la thim pas: rdo rje tshe yi mchog thob bsam: sngags mthar tshe yi rig pa gdags: ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi hrīḥdzaḥbh+rūm̐: skabs su thugs dam bskul ba ni: hrī: so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi: rig pa rang shar rta mchog dpal: gtso 'khor sprul pa yang sprul bcas: thugs dam bskul lo gzi byin skyed: rdo rje sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: dkar la 'tsher ba'i 'od zer dang: pho nya'i tshogs kyi 'phro 'du yis: brtan pa snod kyi dwangs ma khug: pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas: dkar la 'dril ba'i 'od zer dang: pho nya'i tshogs kyi 'phro 'du yis: srid pa bcud kyi tshe dpal khug: 'od gsal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: mthing la 'tsher ba'i 'od zer dang: pho nya'i tshogs kyi 'phro 'du yis: dbyings dang ye shes yon tan khug: rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la stims: 'chi med sgrub pa'i rdzas la khug: mi 'gyur mi shigs rtag pa'i tshe: dbang chen rol pa'i dngos grub stsol: zhes bkug sgrub pa'i rdzas dang ni: tshe yi rten la gnyis med bstim:

yab yum snyoms zhugs rjes chags kyi: bde ba mi phyed rdo rje'i srog: 'od dmar pad+ma rā ga'i phreng: lu gu rgyud kyi thag pa yis: sku bcing rlung rnams dbu mar bcug: thig le tshe rten drwa bar bsdams: cis kyang mi chod mi shigs pa'i: rdo rje gsum gyi srog ldan bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra kā bā tsi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: khyad par rdor bzlas bum can gyi: rnal 'byor zab mos brtan par bya: rtags mthong tshe bum spyi bor blang: oṃ: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kyi: snang ba'i dngos po'i rdo rje'i tshe: mi 'gyur rtag pa'i dngos grub stsol: kā ya a yur+dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi hrīḥdzaḥbh+rūm̐: bdud rtsi mgrin par bzhag cing myang: ā: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kyi: grags pa'i dngos po pad+ma'i tshe: mi shigs dbyangs kyi dngos grub stsol: wā ka ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi hrīḥdzaḥbh+rūm̐: hūm̐: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kyi: rig pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal tshe: 'pho med mchog gi dngos grub stsol: tsit+ta ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi hrīḥdzaḥbh+rūm̐: a: spros pas 'khor 'das khyab pa'i 'od: bsdus pas gong bu gcig tu 'dril: snying dbus mi shigs thig le'i dbus: dbang chen rol pa'i rgyas gdab bo: a a a: mtha' rgyas srog bslu nye 'u 'don: tshogs gtor bsod nams rgya cher gsag: des ni tshe yi bar chad zhi: mthar thug 'chi med mchog 'grub bo: sa ma ya: pad+ma dbang chen tan+t+ra ni: mkha' ltar zab cing rgya che'i don: nā gardzu na'i dgongs pa'i gding: bdag nyid pad+ma rgyal po yis: gdams pa zab cing 'dril ba 'di: ma 'ongs rigs sad skyes bu'i don: 'phel ba'i thig le'i yi ge ni: dwangs ma mi shigs srog tu bzung: dus su babs tshe snod ldan la: snyan brgyud tshul du gdams pa ste: sngon chad gzhan du ma bstan pa'i:

snying po'i snying po 'di kho na: sa ma ya: 'di ni ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus: tshe thung nad mang longs spyod dbul: khyad par bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams: glo bur bar chad sna tshogs pas: phrin las gzhan dbang bsgyur ba dang: bod khams thugs rje'i gdul zhing 'dir: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar la smin: rdzogs pa'i dus su sleb pa na: bod khams kla klo'i dpung mang pos: 'jigs pa chen po ston pa na: dbang chen pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob pa: 'gro 'dul sprul pa rnam gnyis dang: mkhyen rab ye shes gar gyi dbang: snying po'i bstan pa spel ba dang: 'dzin pa'i skyes bu zung bzhi yi: don du gdams pa rdzogs par ston: 'chi ba med pa'i srog 'grub cing: bar chad spyi dang khyad par du: gzhan dbang mang po zil mnan nas: bstan dang 'gro la phan pa dang: sgrub pa'i lam mchog yun ring gnas: 'brel tshad don dang ldan par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ya: dha thim: a ti gu h+ya ma hā man+t+ra sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu:

zhes pa'ang*/ slob dpon chen po nā gardzu nas byin gyis brlabs shing*/ gu ru pad+ma rgyal pos rjes su gdams pa ltar/ rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pa'i skyes bu mchog rnams kyi gtsos las ldan gyi slob ma rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas/ sbas yul chen po a ta rong gi gnas kyi snying po bkra shis dpal gyi ri bo'i gnas zhal gsar du snang bar mdzad pa'i skabs/ gter chen bla ma 'gro 'dul mchog gyur bde chen zhig po gling pa ston 'khor rnams kyi spyan sngar ras dkar gyi gur khyim la brten pa'i sman ljongs nyams dga' bar pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pas skad cig gis gtan la phab pa'i legs byas kyis/ bstan 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs pad brtan cing bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i dge mtshan lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// //
